name: Lucky Lily Villa — Tropical 3BR with Garden & BBQ
description:
Escape to your own tropical oasis in Sanur! This spacious 3-bedroom villa features a private pool surrounded by lush gardens, a BBQ area, and even a fish pond at the entrance — yes, real fish! Perfect for families or remote workers, the villa includes orthopedic beds for a great night's sleep, a dedicated work desk, and superfast Wi-Fi. Just 7 minutes by scooter to Sanur Beach and a short walk to cafes, playgrounds, and groceries — enjoy the perfect mix of privacy and convenience.

Lucky Lily Villa is your private escape — a 3-bedroom hideaway with a huge garden, sparkling private pool, and space to fully relax or create. Guests love the calm, the comfort, and the feeling of finally breathing out.

Guests have exclusive access to the entire villa and all facilities, including: 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 3 toilets, living room with sofa and Apple TV / YouTube Premium, fully equipped kitchen, private swimming pool, sun loungers and umbrellas, outdoor BBQ area with gas grill, large green garden, garden-view workspace, fast Wi-Fi and A/C throughout.

name: Mudra 1 — Eco Private 1BR Pool Villa
description:
Eco-villa built from teak wood in Ungasan with a private pool and tropical atmosphere. 1 bedroom with double bed, AC, enclosed living room with kitchen, Smart TV, terrace, Wi-Fi 200 Mbps. Bike parking, housekeeping 3x/week. 10 minutes to the beach. Perfect for couples, digital nomads and long stays.

Guests have full private access to the entire bungalow and grounds — separate entrance, no shared areas with other guests. The bungalow: bedroom with double bed and AC, garden-view bathroom with hair dryer, towels, shampoo and soap, living room with AC and Smart TV, kitchen with bar counter. Kitchen appliances: refrigerator, stove, microwave, coffee machine, kettle, blender. Outdoor area: private pool with tropical garden, terrace, bike parking. Services: housekeeping 3x per week, pool and garden maintenance on schedule, laundry service available on request.

name: Mudra 2 — Eco Pool 2BR Villa
description:
Eco-style 2BR villa in Ungasan built with natural teak wood, featuring a private pool and peaceful tropical atmosphere. Includes extra-wide 2-meter beds, AC bedrooms, enclosed living room and kitchen, Smart TV, terrace, and fast 200 Mbps Wi-Fi. Free motorbike parking and housekeeping 3x weekly. Just 10 minutes to the beach. Ideal for families and digital nomads.

This cozy eco-style 2-bedroom villa combines natural materials, privacy, and modern comfort for a relaxing stay in Bali. The villa features a private pool and terrace, perfect for enjoying a quiet morning coffee or relaxing after a day at the beach. The enclosed air-conditioned living room and fully equipped kitchen ensure comfort throughout your stay. Both bedrooms include extra-wide 2-meter beds and air conditioning, making the villa ideal for families or longer stays. The villa is located just 10 minutes from the beaches of Ungasan, with cafes, restaurants, and popular southern Bali destinations nearby.

name: Mudra 3 — Exclusive 1BR Pool Villa
description:
Eco-villa made of teak wood in Ungasan with a private pool and tropical atmosphere. 1 bedroom with double bed, air conditioning, enclosed living room with kitchen, Smart TV, terrace, 200 Mbps Wi-Fi. Parking for motorcycles, cleaning 3 times a week. 10 minutes to the beach. Perfect for couples, digital nomads, and extended stays.

Although compact, the villa is thoughtfully designed for a comfortable stay. The enclosed living room features air conditioning, a Smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar — perfect for enjoying your morning coffee, working remotely, or relaxing in the evening. The bedroom offers a comfortable double bed, warm wooden interiors, and plenty of natural light. The bathroom overlooks the tropical garden. Step outside your bedroom and you'll find yourself beside your private swimming pool, surrounded by tropical plants. The villa is located in Ungasan, one of South Bali's most desirable areas — beautiful beaches are only a 10-minute drive away, with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, beach clubs and famous temples within easy reach. Stay productive with high-speed 200 Mbps Wi-Fi and a comfortable workspace.

name: Mudra 4 — Eco 1BR Pool Villa
description: Eco-villa built from natural teak wood in Ungasan with a private pool and tropical atmosphere — part of the Mudra villas complex. 1 bedroom with double bed, air conditioning, enclosed living room with kitchen, Smart TV and terrace. Fast Wi-Fi, housekeeping 3 times a week, pool and garden maintenance included. 10 minutes to the beaches of Ungasan, with cafes, restaurants and beach clubs nearby. Perfect for couples, digital nomads and extended stays. Contact us on WhatsApp for availability and rates.

name: Premier Umalas 16 — Stylish 3BR Pool Townhouse
description:
Stylish 3-bedroom townhouse with private pool in quiet Umalas, 10 min to the beach by scooter. Modern tropical design, peaceful street, great cafes nearby. 140 m2 with three balcony bedrooms, Wi-Fi 200 Mbps, workspaces, Smart TV and fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for families, groups, digital nomads and long stays.

This spacious 140 m2 townhouse spans two floors and is designed for comfortable Bali living — combining coziness, privacy and modern tropical design. On the upper floor are three bright suite bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and balcony. On the ground floor, the living room opens directly to the fully private pool. The house is fully air-conditioned and suits both short holidays and long-term stays.

What's included: private pool, fast Wi-Fi 200 Mbps, comfortable workspaces for remote work, Smart TV (Netflix, Apple TV, YouTube — use your own account), fully equipped kitchen with stove, microwave, coffee machine, blender and kettle, washing machine, safe, iron and ironing board.

name: Premier Umalas 17 — Stylish 2BR Private Pool Home
description:
Stylish 2-bedroom townhouse with a private pool in peaceful Umalas, just 10 minutes from the beach by scooter. Modern tropical design, a quiet street, and great cafes and restaurants nearby create the perfect atmosphere for enjoying Bali. The spacious 100 sqm home features two bedrooms with balconies, fast 200 Mbps Wi-Fi, two comfortable workspaces, Smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for couples, digital nomads, families, and long stays.

This spacious 100 sqm townhouse is spread over two floors and designed for comfortable Bali living, combining privacy, relaxation, and modern tropical design. Upstairs you will find two bright bedroom suites, each with its own private balcony and en-suite bathroom. The living area downstairs opens directly onto the private swimming pool. The house is fully air-conditioned and ideal for both short stays and long-term living.

name: Pungutan 1 — Stylish 2BR Pool Townhouse
description:
Modern 2BR townhouse in Sanur, 15 min walk to the beach. 110 sqm over 2 floors with private 8 sqm pool and terrace. Both bedrooms with king beds and AC, one with work desk. Enclosed living room, Smart TV (Netflix, Apple TV), fast WiFi. Fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, water dispenser and safe. Housekeeping 3x/week. Quiet area, parking for bikes. Ideal for families and long stays.

This brand-new 2-storey townhouse offers a private and comfortable stay in the heart of Sanur. The living room and fully equipped kitchen are located on the ground floor, opening to a private terrace with a plunge pool — completely private and not shared. Upstairs you'll find two bedrooms, both with en-suite bathrooms, plus an additional guest toilet on the ground floor. High ceilings, large windows and plenty of natural light. All rooms are air-conditioned. High-speed Wi-Fi (300 Mbps) makes it ideal for remote work. Private entrance, quiet street, cafes and shops nearby.

name: Pungutan 2 — Modern 2BR Pool Townhouse
description:
110 m2 townhouse on two floors in the quiet Sanur area, 15 minutes' walk from the beach. Two bedrooms with king-size beds, private pool, terrace. Enclosed living room with Smart TV, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, safe, fast Wi-Fi. Cleaning 3 times a week. Perfect for families and long-term stays.

New two-storey townhouse in the heart of Sanur with a private entrance and quiet street. Ground floor: spacious living room with kitchen opens onto a private terrace with its own pool — fully enclosed, just for you. Guest toilet. Second floor: two bedrooms with king-size beds, each with its own bathroom; one bedroom is equipped with a workspace. High ceilings, large windows, plenty of natural light. Air conditioning in all rooms. Internet 300 Mbps. 15 minutes' walk to the beach, cafes, restaurants and shops nearby. Motorbike parking.

name: Tanjung Sari 2 — Spacious 4BR Family Pool Villa
description:
Modern 4BR villa in Sanur near Mertasari Beach, located on a quiet street within walking distance to cafes. Private 35 sqm pool with garden view and 4 sunbeds. All bedrooms with king-size beds, baby cot on request. Fully enclosed living room with AC, large sofa, Smart TV (Netflix, Apple TV) and dining for 8. Equipped kitchen, filtered water dispenser, fast WiFi, parking, housekeeping 3x/week. Ideal for families and groups up to 8 guests.

Spacious 2-storey private villa (235 sqm) in Sanur set on 400 sqm land with a large central swimming pool and private parking. Ground floor features a master bedroom with pool view. Three additional bedrooms are located upstairs. Each bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom with shower and toilet, plus large wardrobes — 5 bathrooms in total including a guest toilet. Fully enclosed living and kitchen area with AC, large sofa and Smart TV. High ceilings, sliding glass doors and plenty of natural light. Perfect for 2-3 families, groups and long stays. Fast WiFi for remote work.

name: Tanjung Sari 3 — 4BR Pool Villa with Garden
description:
Modern 4BR villa in Sanur near Mertasari Beach, located on a quiet street within walking distance to cafes. Private 35 sqm pool with garden view and 4 sunbeds. All bedrooms with king-size beds, baby cot on request. Fully enclosed living room with AC, large sofa, Smart TV (Netflix, Apple TV) and dining for 8. Equipped kitchen, filtered water dispenser, fast WiFi, parking, housekeeping 3x/week. Ideal for families and groups up to 8 guests.

Spacious 2-storey private villa (235 sqm) in Sanur set on 400 sqm land with a large central swimming pool and private parking. Ground floor features a master bedroom with pool view. Three additional bedrooms are located upstairs. Each bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom with shower and toilet, plus large wardrobes — 5 bathrooms in total including a guest toilet. Fully enclosed living and kitchen area with AC, large sofa and Smart TV. High ceilings, sliding glass doors and plenty of natural light. Perfect for 2-3 families, groups and long stays. Fast WiFi for remote work.

name: The Wave — Beachside 6BR Villa in Berawa
description:
Luxury 6-bedroom villa in Canggu, 2-5 minutes' walk from Berawa Beach. Modern luxury interior, large private pool, fast Wi-Fi. Every bedroom with king-size bed and en-suite bathroom. Spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen, dining area. Capacity up to 12 guests. Perfect for families, groups, weddings and corporate events. Canggu's best restaurants, cafes and surf spots within walking distance.

Villa The Wave — an exclusive 6-bedroom residence in the heart of Canggu. Two-storey villa of 341 m2, built in 2023. Modern architecture blends harmoniously with Bali's tropical atmosphere; shades of blue and earth tones reflect the villa's coastal character. Spacious living room with a large sofa and Smart TV, fully equipped kitchen, dining area with soft lighting — large glass doors open directly to the pool. Large private pool surrounded by greenery; on the second floor, a wide balcony with views. 6 spacious bedrooms with quality linen, TV and en-suite bathroom in each, plus a separate guest toilet — 7 bathrooms in total. Included in the price: cleaning 3 times a week, towels for each guest, fast Wi-Fi, safe in every room.

name: Villa Black Pool — Family 4BR Villa with Big Pool
description:
Villa Black Pool is a spacious, modern 4-bedroom villa featuring a stunning private black-tiled pool, lush tropical garden, and stylish open-plan design. Located in a peaceful corner of Sanur, it combines privacy with convenience — just a short walk to the beach, cafes, and shops.

Bedrooms: 4 private bedrooms with A/C, blackout curtains, and garden views; soft linens, fresh towels, and quality mattresses. Each of the 4 bedrooms has a private en-suite bathroom, plus a refreshing outdoor shower by the pool. Fully equipped kitchen with stove, fridge, water filter, and utensils; coffee, tea, and cooking essentials provided. Large open living room with comfortable lounge area and pool view, indoor dining space and shaded outdoor terrace.

Housekeeping 2x a week, bed linens changed every 5 days, pool and garden maintenance 2x a week. High-speed fiber Wi-Fi (300 Mbps) and a work-friendly desk setup — ideal for remote work. Walking distance to Sanur beach, yoga studios, massage spots, and restaurants. Safe, calm area with easy access to Renon, Seminyak, and the airport.

name: Villa Kesari 4 Trees — Tropical Family 3BR Villa
amenities: Private pool with shallow kids' area
description:
Perfect for families, parents, kids, and grandparents — this peaceful Sanur villa offers a safe setting, a private pool with a shallow kids' area, and three spacious en-suite bedrooms. Quiet street, beach just minutes away, cafes and parks nearby. Ideal for families seeking comfort, privacy, and a calm place for children. Fast Wi-Fi and 3x weekly cleaning included — your family oasis in Sanur. Our staff welcomes you, gives a quick tour, explains amenities, and ensures a smooth check-in.

Villa Kesari 4 is a newly built, modern 3-bedroom villa with a private pool, tropical garden, and stylish open-plan design. Tucked away in a quiet Sanur street, it offers the perfect balance of privacy and location — just 8 minutes to the beach.
